entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Now that's my Phantom Thieves![n]I knew they'd pull it off!

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: This definitely proves the[n]justice of the Phantom Thieves!

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: There's no doubt about it![n]I mean, they took Medjed down.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Even the guys who had been[n]criticizing the Phantom Thieves[n]basically have to accept them now!

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: The news has been spreading[n]like wildfire too.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: I'll give it an extra boost[n]on my site as well.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: I bet the approval rating will[n]be through the roof tomorrow.[n]Look forward to it!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: ...Why is he of all people getting excited[n]about this?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Well, the news really did draw a lot of[n]attention. I can't wait to see what happens.
